pre_registered_decision_rules.D1: The paired-bootstrap 95% CI of AUROC(MCB) - AUROC(best baseline among entropy, msp, tta_var, mcdo, entropy_ts) is entirely above 0, OR MCB recall at op_far10 beats the best baseline's with a CI of the paired difference entirely above 0.
pre_registered_decision_rules.D2: The paired-bootstrap 95% CI of AUROC(MCB) - AUROC(cbi_flat) is entirely above 0, OR MCB recall at op_far10 beats cbi_flat's with a CI of the paired difference entirely above 0.
pre_registered_decision_rules.D3: Among base-model errors with c0 >= 0.90 (or top-quartile confidence errors if < 15), report MCB recall vs entropy recall at matched FAR with 95% CIs.
pre_registered_decision_rules.D4: The Wilson score 95% CI lower bound of overall fault-attribution accuracy (Section 8) is above 0.50 (chance = 0.33).
